description: The pie chart is titled "All Changes" and it represents the distribution of different types of changes made by a novel detector-corrector framework for Chinese spelling correction. The chart is divided into five slices, each representing a different type of change. The largest slice, which occupies 50% of the chart, represents the "P" type of change. The second largest slice, which occupies 29% of the chart, represents the "N" type of change. The third largest slice, which occupies 14% of the chart, represents the "PW" type of change. The fourth largest slice, which occupies 4% of the chart, represents the "RW" type of change. The smallest slice, which occupies 1% of the chart, represents the "NW" type of change. The chart does not include any legend or percentage labels inside the slices, and no slices are visually emphasized. The slices are ordered in descending size, with the "P" type of change being the largest and the "NW" type of change being the smallest.
